scope: Independent application reconstruction, all selected-parameter config diffs, baseline equality and bounded outcome interpretation; no simulator rerun or protocol tuning.
interpretation_limits: Three seeds are descriptive observations, not a precision or optimality claim.
300-second freshness has newly admitted control work exactly at finite stop; conservative DataDrained flag includes CONTROL in shared Resends.
Recovery latency describes delivered survivors and includes administrative receive blackout plus scheduled rediscovery stimuli.
No native, long-run, network timing parity, or source-default optimal timeout claim.
